descriptions.w3d_d28g_camera_blend_step_8006f8e8: Camera step: when the target handle at +76 resolves, fetches three target vectors and blends up (+28) and focus (+16) toward them by the rates at +80 and +84; while locked it unlocks past the +96 distance from the position target, and when unlocked it blends the position (+4) by the rate at +88, then extends bounds with +100 and +104.
